endpoint.selection: final scheduled checkpoint; no best-epoch selection

paper_reference.source: Zhang et al., ICML 2025, Table 2, CIFAR-10 top-1 RT-ER

discipline: the epoch130 result remains a single-seed reproduction outcome
matching accuracy does not establish checkpoint identity or theorem applicability
a seed0 pass supports only the existential statement that the released pipeline can reproduce SA within tolerance
a seed0 miss is reported per-run and requires one frozen seed1 reproduction before any pipeline-level insufficiency wording
only two registered misses may support pipeline-level wording, scoped to those two compatibility reproductions and never as proof that the paper result is false
the threshold is not changed after epoch130 is observed
